headlines.headline: Boxing schedule
headlines.description: Want to know what fights are on the horizon? Check out the boxing schedule.
headlines.story:
Want to know what fights are ahead? Check out the 2026 boxing schedule.

For a list of the current champions in all weight classes, click here.

To go directly to a particular month, click one of the links below:

OCTOBER | NOVEMBER | DECEMBER | JANUARY

Boxing pound-for-pound rankings: Men's | Women's

Key dates:

  • Oct. 31: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (DAZN PPV) -- Title fight: Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli, 12 rounds, for Mbilli's WBC super middleweight title
  • Nov. 8: Arlington, Texas (ESPN) -- Title fight: Alycia Baumgardner vs. Elif Nur Turhan, 10 rounds, for Turhan's IBF women's lightweight title
  • Dec. 5: Glendale, Arizona (DAZN and Prime Video PPV) -- Title fight: David Benavidez vs. Michal Cieslak, 12 rounds, for Benavidez's WBA and WBO cruiserweight titles and Cieslak's WBC cruiserweight title
  • Dec. 11: Cardiff, Wales (Netflix) -- Title fight: Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua, 12 rounds, for the vacant WBA "super" heavyweight title
  • Dec. 12: Yekaterinburg, Russia -- Title fight: Dmitry Bivol vs. Callum Smith, 12 rouns, for Bivol's WBA, IBF and WBO light heavyweight titles

Full schedule:

October

Oct. 31: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (DAZN PPV)

  • Title fight: Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli, 12 rounds, for Mbilli's WBC super middleweight title
  • Title fight: Jaime Munguia vs. Nikita Zon, 12 rounds, for Munguia's WBA super middleweight title
  • Title fight: Rafael Espinoza vs. Ricardo Blandon, 12 rounds, for Espinoza's WBO featherweight title
  • Title fight: Lindolfo Delgado vs. Arthur Biyarslanov, 12 rounds, for the vacant IBF junior welterweight title
  • David Picasso vs. Carl Jammes Martin, 12 rounds, junior featherweights
  • Reito Tsutsumi vs. Raymundo Rojas Garcia, 10 rounds, junior lightweights

November

Nov. 7: Manchester, England (DAZN)

  • Joshua Buatsi vs. Willy Hutchinson, 12 rounds, for the vacant WBC interim light heavyweight title
  • Jack Rafferty vs. Hovhannes Martirosyan, 12 rounds, welterweights

Nov. 7: London (Paramount+)

  • Chris Billam-Smith vs. Cheavon Clarke, 10 rounds, cruiserweights
  • Denzel Bentley vs. Shane Mosley Jr., 12 rounds, middleweights
  • Zach Parker vs. Umar Dzambekov, 10 rounds, light heavyweights
  • Lucas Roehrig vs. Connal McDonald, 8 rounds, cruiserweights
  • Da'Mazion Vanhouter vs. Ivan Balaz, 8 rounds, heavyweights
  • Sam Hickey vs. Troy Coleman, 8 rounds, middleweights

Nov. 7: Albuquerque, New Mexico (DAZN)

  • Title fight: Abraham Perez vs. Yankiel Rivera, 12 rounds, for Perez's WBA interim flyweight title

Nov. 8: Arlington, Texas (ESPN)

  • Title fight: Alycia Baumgardner vs. Elif Nur Turhan, 10 rounds, for Turhan's IBF women's lightweight title
  • Title fight: Irma Garcia vs. Nataly Delgado, 10 rounds, for Garcia's IBF women's junior bantamweight title and Delgado's WBA women's juniot bantamweight title
  • Title fight: Ramla Ali vs. Mikiah Kreps, 10 rounds, for the vacant WBO and IBF women's junior featherweight titles
  • Title fight: Skye Nicolson vs. Miyo Yoshida, 10 rounds, for Nicolson's WBC junior featherweight title
  • Title fight: Brittany Sims vs. Shera Mae Patricio, 10 rounds, for the vacant WBA "regular" women's bantamweight title
  • Natalie Dove vs. Nayeli Rodriguez, 8 rounds, flyweights
  • Fernando Garcia vs. Alexander Castellano, 6 rounds, featherweights
  • Javier Guerrero Cruz vs. Aiden Anderson, 6 rounds, welterweights

Nov. 12: Montreal (DAZN)

  • Steven Butler vs. Erik Bazinyan, 12 rounds, super middleweights
  • Jhon Orobio vs. Hendri Cedeno, 10 rounds, junior welterweights
  • Lenar Perez vs. TBA, 10 rounds, cruiserweights
  • Avery Martin Duval vs. TBA, 10 rounds, lightweights
  • Wyatt Sanford vs. TBA, 8 rounds, lightweights
  • Keven Beausejour vs. TBA, 4 rounds, super middleweights
  • Nickenson Denis vs. TBA, 4 rounds, super middleweights

Nov. 14: Carson, California (TNT and DAZN)

  • Diego Pacheco vs. Darius Fulghum, 12 rounds, super middleweights
  • Title fight: Anthony Olascuaga vs. Yuberjen Martinez, 12 rounds, for Olascuaga's WBO flyweight title
  • Charlie Sheehy vs. Gabriel Flores Jr., 10 rounds, lightweights
  • David Adeleye vs. Alexander Flores, 10 rounds, heavyweights
  • Zaquin Moses vs. TBA, 8. rounds, junior lightweights
  • Nishant Dev vs. TBA, 8 rounds, junior middleweights
  • Federico Pacheco Jr. vs. TBA, 8 rounds, heavyweights
  • Frank Espinoza vs. Abisai Torres Diaz, 6 rounds, middleweights

Nov. 14: Levallois-Perret, France

  • Bakary Samake vs. Uisma Lima, 10 rounds, junior middleweights

Nov. 18: Melbourne, Australia (DAZN)

  • Teremoana Teremoana vs. Hemi Ahio, 10 rounds, heavyweights

Nov. 20: Cardiff, Wales

  • Title fight: Lauren Price vs. Michaela Kotaskova, 10 rounds, for Price's IBF, WBA and WBC women's welterweight titles
  • Rhys Edwards vs. Lee McGregor, 10 rounds, featherweights
  • Kyran Jones vs. Sean Arkwright, 10 rounds, middleweights

Nov. 20: Indio, California (DAZN)

  • Amari Jones vs. DeAundre Pettus, 10 rounds, middleweights
  • Title fight: Gabriela Fundora vs. Jasmina Zapotoczna, 10 rounds, for Fundora's undisputed women's flyweight championship

Nov. 28: Dusseldorf, Germany (DAZN)

  • Title fight: Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa, 12 rounds, for Kabayel's WBC heavyweight title

Nov. 29: Tokyo

  • Title fight: David Jimenez vs. Seigo Yuri Akui, 12 rounds, for Jimenez's WBA junior bantamweight title
  • Title fight: Riku Masuda vs. Seiya Tsutsumi, 12 rounds, for Masuda's WBA "regular" bantamweight title
  • Title fight: Kenshiro Teraji vs. Jassiel Ramon Amador Gamez, 12 rounds, for Teraji's WBO junior bantamweight title

December

Dec. 5: Glendale, Arizona (DAZN and Prime Video PPV)

  • Title fight: David Benavidez vs. Michal Cieslak, 12 rounds, for Benavidez's WBA and WBO cruiserweight titles and Cieslak's WBC cruiserweight title
  • Vergil Ortiz Jr. vs. Keith Thurman, 12 rounds, middleweights
  • Emiliano Vargas vs. TBA, 10 rounds, junior welterweights
  • Marco Romero vs. TBA, 8 rounds, middleweights
  • Nikita Tszyu vs. TBA, 8 rounds, junior middleweights

Dec. 5: Wolverhampton, England (DAZN)

  • Conah Walker vs. Alexis Rocha, 10 rounds, welterweights

Dec. 11: Cardiff, Wales (Netflix)

  • Title fight: Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua, 12 rounds, for the vacant WBA "super" heavyweight title

Dec. 12: Yekaterinburg, Russia

  • Title fight: Dmitry Bivol vs. Callum Smith, 12 rouns, for Bivol's WBA, IBF and WBO light heavyweight titles

Dec. 12: Monte Carlo, Monaco (DAZN)

  • Michel Soro vs. George Liddard, 12 rounds, middleweights
  • Josh Padley vs. Moussa Gholam, 12 rounds, junior lightweights

Dec. 19: Belfast, Northern Ireland (DAZN)

  • Title fight: Anthony Cacace vs. Nick Ball, 12 rounds, for Cacace's WBA junior lightweight title

January

Jan. 9: Bournemouth, England (DAZN)

  • Ryan Garner vs. James Dickens, 12 rounds, for Garner's WBC interim junior lightweight title

Jan. 23: Horsens, Denmark

  • Title fight: Jacob Bank vs. Zhanibek Alimkhanuly, 12 rounds, for the vacant WBO super middleweight title
